item: on Windows an unresolved asyncio proactor makes airplane mode's guard refuse to arm
summary: R643 patches asyncio.windows_events.IocpProactor.connect and .sendto. If a future Python renamed the class, dropped a method or failed to import the module, the guard used to install without those points and arm anyway. install_airplane_socket_guard now logs a fixed refusal at error level and stays unarmed, so the serving gate (R644) answers 503. Release line: on Windows, if a future Python changes the event-loop internals airplane mode relies on, the app now refuses to serve and says why, instead of running with part of airplane mode's guard missing.
